title: Saver fare: changes
text: Saver fares can be changed up to 4 hours before departure for a fee of 2,500 rupees plus any fare difference. No changes within 4 hours.
note: Fictional rules for a fictional travel company.

title: Saver fare: cancellation
text: Saver fares are non-refundable except for taxes, which are refunded on cancellation. Refunds reach the original payment method in 7 working days.
note: Fictional rules for a fictional travel company.

title: Flex fare: changes and cancellation
text: Flex fares allow one free change and cancellation with a 10% fee up to 2 hours before departure.
note: Fictional rules for a fictional travel company.

title: Hotel free cancellation
text: Rooms marked free cancellation can be cancelled without charge until 48 hours before check-in. Later cancellations are charged one night.
note: Fictional rules for a fictional travel company.

title: Rail booking changes
text: Rail tickets cannot be changed; cancel and rebook instead. Cancellation charges depend on class and time before departure.
note: Fictional rules for a fictional travel company.

title: Package holidays
text: Package holidays can be cancelled with a 20% fee up to 30 days before departure and 50% after that. Travel insurance may cover the fee.
note: Fictional rules for a fictional travel company.

title: Weather disruption
text: If an airline cancels a flight because of weather, Safarnova offers a free rebooking on the next available flight or a full refund.
note: Fictional rules for a fictional travel company.

title: Group bookings
text: Bookings for 5 or more passengers are handled as group bookings with separate change rules agreed at booking.
note: Fictional rules for a fictional travel company.
